digest.component_or_area: code-review trigger routing and project overlays
propositions: The rebar project exhibits 35.3% trigger fire-rate (13.3% committed high-precision tier + 22.0% noisy tier) when replayed over 300 non-merge commits, with three corpus bugs triggering only through noisy-tier vocabulary (.lock, retry, Popen).

Project-extension mechanism must enable additive concurrency overlay vocabulary in .rebar/criteria_routing.json with trigger_tokens and applies_to glob patterns without duplicating or conflicting with committed routing.

Two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision tier + project noisy tier) must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with fire-rate tradeoff measurements, methodology, and this repo as worked example.

Config-effect test must verify that diffs containing project-only tokens (e.g., index.lock) fire the concurrency overlay under repo-specific routing but not under committed-only routing, validating the real read path.
